sentences.text:
This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as he has been arrested on 27.4.2023 in connection with Crime No.144/2023 registered at Police Station Dharnavada, District Guna for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of IPC Aman Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17543310/
1 and under Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
Prosecution story, in brief is that the applicant kidnapped/abducted minor prosecutrix aged about 17 years and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix was major at the time of incident and she in her statement recorded during investigation under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. specifically stated that she herself called the applicant who eloped her at her aunt's house and did not commit any wrong with her.

 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Case diary is available.
With the consent, heard finally.
This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant as he has been arrested on 27.4.2023 in connection with Crime No.144/2023 registered at Police Station Dharnavada, District Guna for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of IPC Aman Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17543310/
1 and under Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
Prosecution story, in brief is that the applicant kidnapped/abducted minor prosecutrix aged about 17 years and committed rape upon her.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the prosecutrix was major at the time of incident and she in her statement recorded during investigation under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. specifically stated that she herself called the applicant who eloped her at her aunt's house and did not commit any wrong with her.
opennyai_summary.19_June_2023__decision:
No offence is made out against the applicant.
He is in custody since 27.4.2023.
Trial will take time to conclude and therefore, in the aforesaid circumstances, applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
Having considered rival submission, statement of the prosecutrix recorded during investigation under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., material produced on record with regard to her age and over all facts and circumstances, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail,
hence the application is allowed.
It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr.P.C.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.

Author: Deepak Kumar Agarwal
Bench: Deepak Kumar Agarwal
IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH AT GWALIOR CRA No. 12062 of 2022 (AMAN KUSHWAH Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH)
Dated : 21-07-2023 Shri Upendra Yadav,
learned counsel for petitioner.
Shri V.P.S. Tomar, learned Panel Lawyer for State.
Heard on IA.No.90/2023, 1st application u/Sec.
389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant- Aman Kushwah.
Vide judgment dated 17.11.2022 passed in S.T. No.194/2019 by learned Special Judge (POCSO Act)
and 13th Additional Sessions Judge District Gwalior appellant has been convicted under Section 376(1) of IPC and sentenced to undergo 10 years RI with fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulation.
opennyai_summary.facts:
On 17.12.2018 present appellant came at the house of her maternal uncle.
On 17.12.2018 present appellant after taking permission of her maternal grandmother, took her to Achleshwar Temple.
After darshan, he took her to Krishna Lodge Hotel situated at Nai Sadak where he forcibly committed sexual intercourse with her.
She did not disclose the incident to her family members.
After 5-6 days, present appellant told her that he took her obscene photographs and threatened her that if she would not make physical relations with her again, he would viral her photographs and thereafter viraled her photographs.
On her complaint, after one and a half months the offence was registered.
After conclusion of trial, learned Trial Court convicted the appellant for the aforesaid offences.
During trial, appellant has suffered incarceration of about more than 14 months.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Final hearing of the appeal will take time and they have a good case on merits.
the appellant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the directions and conditions which may be imposed by the Court.
Therefore, prayer for suspension of sentence has been made.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting upon merits of the case, IA.No.90/2023 is allowed and it is directed that jail sentence of appellant will remain under suspension subject to verification that amount of fine has been deposited, on appellant's furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 20th November, 2023 and on such further dates as may be fixed by the office in this regard till disposal of the appeal.
